decisions.reason: The decision to add chapter images before final editing and layout does not resolve or change whether AI-generated images are editorially suitable.
The timing of chapter-image integration does not change the title-page content or the requirement to omit the literal newline artifact.
The source concerns when chapter images will be added, not the authoritative manuscript revision or the approved textual rewrites.
Adding images before editing and layout are finalized establishes image-integration timing but does not alter the manuscript's editorial objective or approved prose.
The chapter-image integration timing does not change the requested guidance on successfully publishing the paperback.
